```{r}

#Regression attempt 
# Load necessary libraries
library(dplyr)
library(caret)
library(glmnet)
library(ggplot2)

# Step 1: Read and Preprocess the Data
data <- read_excel("Cleaned_Clinical_Trial_Data.xlsx", 
    col_types = c("text","numeric", "text", "text", 
        "text", "text", "text", "text", "text", 
        "text", "text", "text", "text", "text", 
        "text", "text", "numeric", "numeric", 
        "numeric", "numeric", "numeric", "numeric", 
        "numeric", "numeric", "numeric", "numeric", "numeric", 
        "numeric", "numeric", "numeric", 
        "numeric", "numeric", "numeric", "numeric", 
        "numeric", "numeric", "numeric", "numeric", 
        "text", "text", "numeric", "numeric", 
        "numeric", "numeric", "numeric", 
        "numeric", "numeric", "numeric", 
        "numeric", "numeric", "numeric", 
        "numeric", "numeric", "numeric", 
        "numeric", "numeric", "numeric"))

# Add Death Rate Column
if ("Withdrew_Due_To_Death" %in% colnames(data) & "Number_Enrolled_In_Trial" %in% colnames(data)) {
  # Calculate death_rate while avoiding division by zero
  data <- data %>%
    mutate(death_rate = ifelse(Number_Enrolled_In_Trial > 0,
                               Withdrew_Due_To_Death / Number_Enrolled_In_Trial,
                               NA))
  cat("Death rate column added successfully.\n")
} else {
  stop("Columns 'Withdrew_Due_To_Death' or 'Number_Enrolled_In_Trial' are not present in the dataset.")
}

# Variables to exclude
excluded_vars <- c("Trial_number",
    "Withdrawl_Rate_Without_Clear_Reason_In_Control_Arm",
    "Withdrawl_Rate_Without_Clear_Reason_Interventional_Arm",
    "Unspecified_Loss_To_F/U",
    "Total_N_For_Other_Reasonsof_Withdrawl",
    "Number_Withdrew_From_Control_Arm",
    "Number_Withdrew_From_Control_Arm_Due_To_Adverse_Event",
    "Number_Withdrew_From_Control_Arm_Due_To_Progression_Of_Dz",
    "Number_Withdrew_From_Control_Arm_Due_Patient_Withdrawl_Of_Consent",
    "Total_Withdrawl/Discontinuation",
    "Total_Withdrawl_Of_Patient_Consent_W/O_Clear_Reasons",
    "Total_Withdrew_Due_To_Progression_Of_Dz",
    "Total_Withdrawl_Due_To_Complicating_Medical_Disease",
    "Total_Withdrawl__To_Seek_Alternative_Tx",
    "Total_Investigator_Initated_Withdrawl_Due_To_No_Longer_Meeting_Study_Eligibility_Criteria",
    "Withdrew_By_Sponser_Due_To_Non-Compliance",
    "Number_Withdrew_From_Treatment_Arm",
    "Withdrew_Due_To_Death",
    "Treatment_Related_Discontinuation__In_Control_Arm",
    "Number_Withdrew_From_Treatment_Arm_Due_To_Progression_Of_Disease",
    "Number_Withdrew_From_Treatment_Arm_Due_Patient_Withdrawl_Of_Consent"
)




# Step 2: Rename target column to `outcome` if needed
if ("Total_Withdrawl_Rate_Without_Clear_Reason" %in% colnames(data)) {
  data <- data %>%
    rename(outcome = Total_Withdrawl_Rate_Without_Clear_Reason)
} else if (!"outcome" %in% colnames(data)) {
  stop("The target variable `outcome` or `Total_Withdrawl_Rate_Without_Clear_Reason` is not found in the dataset.")
}

# Rest of the script continues...

# Step 3: Preprocess the dataset
# Handle missing values
if (any(is.na(data$outcome))) {
  cat("Removing rows with missing `outcome` values.\n")
  data <- data %>%
    filter(!is.na(outcome))
}

# Ensure `outcome` is numeric
if (!is.numeric(data$outcome)) {
  cat("Converting `outcome` to numeric.\n")
  data$outcome <- as.numeric(data$outcome)
}

# Check for sufficient data points
if (length(unique(data$outcome)) < 2) {
  stop("The target variable `outcome` must have at least two distinct data points.")
}

# Ensure sufficient dataset size
if (nrow(data) < 10) {
  stop("The dataset does not contain enough rows for partitioning.")
}

# Ensure Follow_Up_Period_Years is numeric
if (!is.numeric(data$Follow_Up_Period_Years)) {
    cat("Converting Follow_Up_Period_Years to numeric.\n")
    data$Follow_Up_Period_Years <- as.numeric(data$Follow_Up_Period_Years)
}

# Step 4: Split dataset into training (80%), validation (10%), and test (10%) sets
set.seed(123)
trainIndex <- createDataPartition(data$outcome, p = 0.8, list = FALSE)
train_data <- data[trainIndex, ]
remaining_data <- data[-trainIndex, ]

set.seed(123)
valIndex <- createDataPartition(remaining_data$outcome, p = 0.5, list = FALSE)
validation_data <- remaining_data[valIndex, ]
test_data <- remaining_data[-valIndex, ]

cat("Training set size:", nrow(train_data), "\n")
cat("Validation set size:", nrow(validation_data), "\n")
cat("Test set size:", nrow(test_data), "\n")

# Step 5: Separate predictors and outcome
train_outcome <- train_data$outcome
validation_outcome <- validation_data$outcome
test_outcome <- test_data$outcome

train_data <- train_data %>% select(-outcome)
validation_data <- validation_data %>% select(-outcome)
test_data <- test_data %>% select(-outcome)

# Remove excluded variables
train_data <- train_data %>% select(-one_of(excluded_vars))
validation_data <- validation_data %>% select(-one_of(excluded_vars))
test_data <- test_data %>% select(-one_of(excluded_vars))

# Step 6: Convert factor columns to dummy variables using the same `dummyVars` object
dummy <- dummyVars(" ~ .", data = train_data)  # Create dummyVars object using training data

# Transform the datasets using the same dummyVars object
train_data_numeric <- as.data.frame(predict(dummy, newdata = train_data))
validation_data_numeric <- as.data.frame(predict(dummy, newdata = validation_data))
#test_data_numeric <- as.data.frame(predict(dummy, newdata = test_data))

# Function to add missing columns with zeros
add_missing_columns <- function(reference_data, target_data) {
  # Identify columns in reference_data that are missing in target_data
  missing_cols <- setdiff(colnames(reference_data), colnames(target_data))
  
  # Add missing columns to target_data, initializing them with zeros
  if (length(missing_cols) > 0) {
    for (col in missing_cols) {
      target_data[[col]] <- 0
    }
  }
  
  # Reorder columns in target_data to match reference_data
  target_data <- target_data[, colnames(reference_data)]
  return(target_data)
}

# Ensure consistency in columns by adding missing columns with zeros
validation_data_numeric <- add_missing_columns(train_data_numeric, validation_data_numeric)
test_data_numeric <- add_missing_columns(train_data_numeric, test_data_numeric)

# Add missing columns to validation and test datasets
validation_data_numeric <- add_missing_columns(train_data_numeric, validation_data_numeric)
test_data_numeric <- add_missing_columns(train_data_numeric, test_data_numeric)

# Check that all datasets now have the same number of columns
cat("Number of columns in train_data_numeric:", ncol(train_data_numeric), "\n")
cat("Number of columns in validation_data_numeric:", ncol(validation_data_numeric), "\n")
cat("Number of columns in test_data_numeric:", ncol(test_data_numeric), "\n")

# Inspect dummy variables
cat("Dummy variable columns for Follow_Up_Period_Years:\n")
print(grep("Follow_Up_Period_Years", colnames(train_data_numeric), value = TRUE))

# Step 7: Impute missing values
preProc <- preProcess(train_data_numeric, method = "medianImpute")  # Create preprocessing object

# Impute missing values in all datasets
train_data_imputed <- predict(preProc, train_data_numeric)
validation_data_imputed <- predict(preProc, validation_data_numeric)
test_data_imputed <- predict(preProc, test_data_numeric)

# Convert datasets to matrices for glmnet
train_matrix <- as.matrix(train_data_imputed)
validation_matrix <- as.matrix(validation_data_imputed)
test_matrix <- as.matrix(test_data_imputed)

# Ensure all matrices have consistent dimensions
cat("Number of columns in train_matrix:", ncol(train_matrix), "\n")
cat("Number of columns in validation_matrix:", ncol(validation_matrix), "\n")
cat("Number of columns in test_matrix:", ncol(test_matrix), "\n")

# Step 8: Fit Ridge regression model with cross-validation
set.seed(123)
cv_ridge <- cv.glmnet(
    train_matrix, train_outcome,
    alpha = 0,  # Ridge regression
    lambda = 10^seq(10, -2, length = 100),
    standardize = TRUE,
    nfolds = 10
)

# Optimal lambda
best_lambda <- cv_ridge$lambda.min
cat("Best lambda for ridge regularization:", best_lambda, "\n")

# Final Ridge regression model
ridge_model <- glmnet(
    train_matrix, train_outcome,
    alpha = 0,
    lambda = best_lambda,
    standardize = TRUE
)

# Step 9: Evaluate the model
# Training set performance
train_predictions <- predict(ridge_model, s = best_lambda, newx = train_matrix)
train_rss <- sum((train_outcome - train_predictions)^2)
train_tss <- sum((train_outcome - mean(train_outcome))^2)
train_r_squared <- 1 - train_rss / train_tss
cat("Training R-squared:", train_r_squared, "\n")

# Validation set performance
validation_predictions <- predict(ridge_model, s = best_lambda, newx = validation_matrix)
validation_rss <- sum((validation_outcome - validation_predictions)^2)
validation_tss <- sum((validation_outcome - mean(validation_outcome))^2)
validation_r_squared <- 1 - validation_rss / validation_tss
cat("Validation R-squared:", validation_r_squared, "\n")

# Test set performance
test_predictions <- predict(ridge_model, s = best_lambda, newx = test_matrix)
test_rss <- sum((test_outcome - test_predictions)^2)
test_tss <- sum((test_outcome - mean(test_outcome))^2)
test_r_squared <- 1 - test_rss / test_tss
cat("Test R-squared:", test_r_squared, "\n")

# Step 10: Visualize observed vs predicted values for the test set
test_predictions <- as.vector(test_predictions)
test_results <- data.frame(Observed = test_outcome, Predicted = test_predictions)
ggplot(test_results, aes(x = Predicted, y = Observed)) +
    geom_point() +
    geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, color = "red", linetype = "dashed") +
    labs(title = "Observed vs Predicted Plot - Test Set",
         x = "Predicted Values",
         y = "Observed Values") +
    theme_minimal()

ridge_coefficients <- coef(ridge_model, s = best_lambda)
retained_variables <- as.data.frame(as.matrix(ridge_coefficients))
colnames(retained_variables) <- c("Coefficient")
retained_variables <- retained_variables[retained_variables$Coefficient != 0, , drop = FALSE]
print(retained_variables)
```



```{r}
library(tibble)

# Sort retained variables by absolute coefficient value
retained_variables <- retained_variables %>%
    rownames_to_column("Variable") %>%
    mutate(AbsCoefficient = abs(Coefficient)) %>%
    arrange(desc(AbsCoefficient))

# Display top 10 most influential variables
cat("Top 10 most influential variables based on coefficients:\n")
print(head(retained_variables, 10))
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)

# Step 1: Read and Preprocess the Data

        "text", "text", "text", "text", "text", 
        "text", "text", "text", "text", "text", 
        "text", "text", "numeric", "numeric", 
        "numeric", "numeric", "numeric", "numeric", 
        "numeric", "numeric", "numeric", "numeric", "numeric", 
        "numeric", "numeric", "numeric", 
        "numeric", "numeric", "numeric", "numeric", 
        "numeric", "numeric", "numeric", "numeric", 
        "text", "text", "numeric", "numeric", 
        "numeric", "numeric", "numeric", 
        "numeric", "numeric", "numeric", 
        "numeric", "numeric", "numeric", 
        "numeric", "numeric", "numeric", 
        "numeric", "numeric", "numeric"))

# Add Death Rate Column
if ("Withdrew_Due_To_Death" %in% colnames(data) & "Number_Enrolled_In_Trial" %in% colnames(data)) {
  data <- data %>%
    mutate(death_rate = ifelse(Number_Enrolled_In_Trial > 0,
                               Withdrew_Due_To_Death / Number_Enrolled_In_Trial,

  cat("Death rate column added successfully.\n")
} else {
  stop("Columns 'Withdrew_Due_To_Death' or 'Number_Enrolled_In_Trial' are not present in the dataset.")

# Variables to exclude

    "Withdrawl_Rate_Without_Clear_Reason_In_Control_Arm",
```

```{r}
# Ensure consistent levels between datasets
match_levels <- function(reference_data, target_data) {
  for (col in colnames(reference_data)) {
    if (is.factor(reference_data[[col]]) && col %in% colnames(target_data)) {
      target_data[[col]] <- factor(target_data[[col]], levels = levels(reference_data[[col]]))
    }
  }
  return(target_data)
}
```

```{r}
# Function to add missing columns with default values (0) to match reference data
add_missing_columns <- function(reference_data, target_data) {
  missing_cols <- setdiff(names(reference_data), names(target_data))
  for (col in missing_cols) {
    target_data[[col]] <- 0  # Add missing columns with default value 0
  }
  # Reorder columns to match reference data
  target_data <- target_data[, names(reference_data), drop = FALSE]
  return(target_data)
}

# Add missing columns to validation and test datasets
validation_data_numeric <- add_missing_columns(train_data_numeric, validation_data_numeric)
test_data_numeric <- add_missing_columns(train_data_numeric, test_data_numeric)

preProc <- preProcess(train_data_numeric, method = "medianImpute")
train_data_numeric <- predict(preProc, train_data_numeric)
validation_data_numeric <- predict(preProc, validation_data_numeric)
test_data_numeric <- predict(preProc, test_data_numeric)

# Step 6: Fit Random Forest Model
set.seed(123)
rf_model <- randomForest(
    x = train_data_numeric,
    y = train_outcome,
    ntree = 500,
    mtry = floor(sqrt(ncol(train_data_numeric))),
    importance = TRUE
)

# Step 7: Evaluate Model Performance
# Training set predictions
train_predictions <- predict(rf_model, newdata = train_data_numeric)
train_r_squared <- 1 - sum((train_outcome - train_predictions)^2) / sum((train_outcome - mean(train_outcome))^2)
cat("Training R-squared:", train_r_squared, "\n")

# Validation set predictions
validation_predictions <- predict(rf_model, newdata = validation_data_numeric)
validation_r_squared <- 1 - sum((validation_outcome - validation_predictions)^2) / sum((validation_outcome - mean(validation_outcome))^2)
cat("Validation R-squared:", validation_r_squared, "\n")

# Test set predictions
test_predictions <- predict(rf_model, newdata = test_data_numeric)
test_r_squared <- 1 - sum((test_outcome - test_predictions)^2) / sum((test_outcome - mean(test_outcome))^2)
cat("Test R-squared:", test_r_squared, "\n")

# Step 8: Feature Importance
importance_values <- importance(rf_model)
cat("Feature importance:\n")
print(importance_values)

# Step 9: Visualize Observed vs Predicted Values
test_results <- data.frame(Observed = test_outcome, Predicted = test_predictions)
ggplot(test_results, aes(x = Predicted, y = Observed)) +
    geom_point() +
    geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, color = "red", linetype = "dashed") +
    labs(title = "Observed vs Predicted Plot - Test Set",
         x = "Predicted Values",
         y = "Observed Values") +
    theme_minimal()
```
